Now we need to craft 3-day itinerary.

Day 1: March 15 travel from Oakland to Tucson. Flight details. Arrival. Breakfast maybe at home before flight? Could note "Breakfast: Home". Lunch in Tucson after arrival, maybe "Villa Tevere". Afternoon attraction: Pima Air & Space Museum. Dinner: La Plage (seafood). Accommodation: Private room with private bathroom.

Day 2: March 16 full day Tucson. Breakfast: "Mocha". Morning attraction: Arizona-Sonora Desert Museum. Lunch: "Consort Restaurant". Afternoon attraction: Tucson Botanical Gardens. Dinner: "Culture Club - Bar De Tapas". Accommodation same.

Day 3: March 17 depart? Could just have morning attraction maybe "Sabino Canyon". Breakfast: "Uraki". Lunch: "Pizza Street". Then travel back? Not required but itinerary ends in Tucson. Could include flight back? Not asked, just heading to Tucson. So day 3 can be local.

Now calculate costs: Flight $190. Accommodation 2 nights $58*2 = $116. Meals: average cost: breakfast $12, lunch $20, dinner $30 per day => $62*3 = $186. Attractions: many have entry fees: Pima Air museum free, Desert Museum $24. Botanical Gardens $10, Sabino Canyon $6. Total $40. Transportation within city maybe taxi $20 per day = $60. Sum: 190+116+186+40+60 = $592. Well within budget.
